title: Windows Update compliance
pitch: See the whole fleet's patch state in one bar, then the five hosts that need you and the two that are overdue.
makeItYours: Fill the server rows from your update tooling's export (WSUS, Configuration Manager or Intune) instead of the inline list.
Change the 30-day overdue rule and the ring names to match your patch policy.
Add a column for the maintenance window so the overdue list doubles as a schedule.
useCase: Use it when the monthly patch report has to answer how many servers are compliant and which ones are not.
